candidates.hypothesis: Code-specific hurdle/chase form, mark baselines, debut indicators and learned uncertainty improve forecasts of chase debutants and returning jumpers.
implementation_prerequisites: Rebuild historical features consistently for training and prediction; distinguish flat turf/AW/hurdle/chase/bumper.
Preserve enough observations for a universal fallback and test interactions rather than replacing scores by hand.

candidates.hypothesis: Prior-only beaten margins, opposition strength, field size and race class distinguish flattering small-field wins and remote places from competitive ability.
implementation_prerequisites: Only completed earlier races may supply outcome-bearing performance features.
Historical subsequent-winner cohort data must be reconstructed as of each cutoff, not today's study date.

candidates.hypothesis: Learned uncertainty for sparse form, code/ground/trip changes and unmeasured opposition improves calibration.
implementation_prerequisites: Test on chronological folds with sufficient juvenile, debut and transition cases.
Do not set a hard probability cap to fit yesterday's outcomes.

candidates.hypothesis: Timestamped pre-race ratings contribute information when the model and card performance measures disagree.
implementation_prerequisites: Acquire genuine historical pre-race card RPR/TS snapshots; current-race achieved ratings cannot substitute.
Missing ratings are missing evidence, not poor ability.

candidates.hypothesis: Recent descriptive running styles, including unknown classifications and rival pace pressure, add information beyond form.
implementation_prerequisites: Parse equipment/post preliminaries separately; retain individual runs and classification coverage.
Test interactions with track, trip, draw and going; do not call a contested lead a guaranteed pace collapse.

candidates.hypothesis: Time since winning mark, recent finishing strength and rating-change interactions improve over raw pounds-below-last-win comparisons.
implementation_prerequisites: Keep hurdle/chase and turf/AW winning-mark comparisons distinct.
Validate nonlinear recency effects; do not veto every older or poor-last-time runner.

selection_process_changes: Display automatic model leaders separately from human selections and price-qualified bets.
An unvalidated model/price discrepancy is not a demonstrated betting edge.
Show unresolved opposition and conditions evidence in the recommendation itself.
Do not force five legs when the evidence supports fewer; win probabilities alone cannot establish each-way value without place probabilities and executable terms.
Never count a placed horse as a successful win selection or a non-runner as a defeat.
validation_protocol: Freeze definitions and chronological development folds before fitting.
Compare candidate out-of-fold log loss, Brier, top-one accuracy and calibration against fixed model and timestamped market references on identical fields/cutoffs.
Keep controls for winners as well as losers; a rule explaining one loss can wrongly discard Castlemont-type winners.
Preregister a genuinely later, untouched holdout period only once configurations are frozen and sufficient new data is available.
Never reopen the retired June–September2026 test as independent evidence.
No new accuracy, profitability or promotion claim until independent evidence supports it.
